status: DRAFT FOR REVIEW (Nov 17, 2026). Not used by any run that produces reported results. Protocols v1 (step6-v1), v2 (step6-v2), the SHAP pilot spec and G4 (step6-g4-diagnostic-1) are unchanged; their pilots are never pooled with v3 results.
requirements: original Step 6 v2 plan: exhaustive evaluation, G1-G6, DEF-1, DEF-2

data.source: official TRAINING partition only (data/raw/UNSW_NB15_testing-set.csv, 175,341 rows; file names are swapped). The official test partition stays locked for the single final evaluation (D10).
data.grouping: G-1: a group is the set of rows with an identical 42-feature vector; a group is never split across train/validation or across any CV fold
data.label_conflicts: C-1: groups with both labels (229 groups, 940 rows in the official training partition) are excluded from the v3 split; sensitivity analysis keeps them whole (stratum LabelConflict)
data.category_conflicts: C-2: attack groups with several attack categories (stratum MixedAttack) are kept; per-category metrics use each row's own category; they are not eligible for the attack sample

split.name: v3 duplicate-disjoint split
split.method: StratifiedGroupKFold(n_splits=5, shuffle=True, random_state=42) on strata = group category (uniform category, MixedAttack or LabelConflict) and groups = G-1; first fold = validation
split.audit: src.unsw.v3_data.audit; the split is used only if shared feature vectors = 0

data.old_split: the v1/v2 random 80/20 split (46.6% of its validation rows have an exact copy in its sub-training part) stays unchanged for the pilots and is not used by v3

models.pipelines: src.unsw.v3_pipelines.build_pipeline (one-hot categoricals; StandardScaler for MLP and LR)

feature_sets.no_ttl39: without sttl, dttl, ct_state_ttl (dropped inside the pipeline)

models.ttl_ablation: option A: full42 and no_ttl39 models are tuned separately with the same procedure

nested_cv.applies_to: the v3 TRAIN side only (random, grouped, category-stratified folds). This is NOT time-based validation.
nested_cv.final_selection: after nested CV: one inner-style search (3 grouped folds, same space and trials) on the whole v3 train side; refit; save to results/models_v3/{model}_{feature_set}.joblib; SHA-256 pinned in the final v3 protocol
nested_cv.implementation: experiments/unsw_nested_cv.py (resumable per model x feature set x unit)

attack_sample.pool: v3 validation side, label attack, no label conflict, uniform category (not MixedAttack)
attack_sample.eligibility: predicted attack by all three primary full42 final models; no_ttl39 detection is reported per model, not used for selection

tiers.tier1: singleton groups (the vector occurs once in the official training partition)
tiers.tier2: only if tier 1 has fewer than 30 eligible flows in a category: one representative row (lowest id) per non-singleton uniform group

attack_sample.draw: numpy.random.default_rng(2026), stratified by flow type (TCP session vs other) in proportion to the eligible pool
attack_sample.exclusions: the 10 v2 pilot flows (by official id)
attack_sample.identity: each flow pinned by its official id and feature hash
attack_sample.shortfall: recorded, never filled from another category or from the test set; Worms is expected to fall short (about 26 rows on the validation side)

time_split_robustness_S2.role: separate robustness study; never used for model selection of the official-partition models, never evaluated on the official test partition, never pooled
time_split_robustness_S2.data: raw Feb 18 records (UNSW-NB15_2..4), categories cleaned, blank ct_flw_http_mthd/is_ftp_login/ct_ftp_cmd filled with 0, rate rebuilt
time_split_robustness_S2.validation: CHRONOLOGICAL: earlier 80% of time = training block, last 20% = test block; tuning inside the training block by forward-chaining (rolling-origin) folds, not random folds
time_split_robustness_S2.proportions: natural class proportions (primary); a class-balanced version only as a labelled sensitivity analysis
time_split_robustness_S2.duplicates: exact duplicates of training-block vectors are removed from the test block and counted
time_split_robustness_S2.isolation: the raw records include records of the locked official test partition; therefore no S2 model, score or choice is used for the official-partition models or for D10, and the official test partition is not opened to filter them
time_split_robustness_S2.status: postponed: no raw-data training until this isolation design is approved

statistics.P2: unchanged from v2 (Wilcoxon signed-rank, Holm over 4 tests); fallback none adopted
statistics.duplicates: results reported separately for tier 1 and tier 2 flows

kept_from_v2: success criteria D8, D11, confirmation D14
official_test_set: locked; a single predeclared final evaluation (D10) after all choices are frozen
